name: country-data
description:
## Country data (`countryData`)
Shared country directory using the imported schema at `/apps/petworld/apis/countries-api`. Because metadata does not expose a valid opaque API ID, transport uses builtin `$http.post` against https://countries.trevorblades.com/ rather than pretending generated API injection works. Only `$http` and `$q` are injected; all network logic stays private to this service.
Public state: `countries`, `continents`, `loading`, `error`, `lastUpdated`. Public methods: `loadCountries(force=false)`, `loadContinents(force=false)`, `getCountry(code)`, `clearCache()`. Loads return digest-friendly Angular promises, cache successful results for ten minutes, and share pending requests even when forced. Continents are derived from fetched countries, not separately requested. Records and continents are sorted by name; languages contain language names. No fake data or travel rules. Failed refreshes retain previous data but reject with a safe error. Clearing cache invalidates outstanding results without cancelling HTTP requests; invalidated callers reject and cannot repopulate state.

variables.name: countries
variables.description: Cached normalized country records: code, name, native, emoji, capital, currency, phone, continentCode, continentName, and languages (string array of language names). Sorted by name; capital and currency default to 'Not listed' when absent. Treat as read-only.

variables.name: continents
variables.description: Unique {code, name} continents derived from successful country loads, sorted by name. Treat as read-only.

variables.name: loading
variables.description: True while the currently valid shared country request is pending; also covers continent loads.

variables.name: error
variables.description: Safe user-facing message for the latest load failure, or null. GraphQL errors are checked even on HTTP 200; raw server errors are never exposed.

variables.name: lastUpdated
variables.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last successful load, or null when uncached.

variables.name: inFlight
variables.description: Private shared Angular promise for the active fetch.

variables.name: loadCountries
variables.description: Returns an Angular promise of normalized countries. Omitted force defaults to false; true bypasses the ten-minute cache but still shares any pending request. Updates public state on success; rejects with a safe Error on transport, GraphQL, or response failures.

variables.name: loadContinents
variables.description: Returns an Angular promise of unique {code, name} continents sorted by name, derived by loadCountries(force). Defaults force to false and shares the same cache, request, loading state, and errors.

variables.name: getCountry
variables.description: Loads countries through the shared cache, then finds a country using a trimmed uppercase code. Returns an Angular promise of the normalized record; rejects with a not-found Error when no match exists.

variables.name: clearCache
variables.description: Clears both cached arrays, timestamp, error, and loading state. Invalidates pending results so they cannot restore stale data or alter subsequent loads; does not cancel the underlying HTTP transport.
